summary: Perion Network filed a Form 6-K announcing Q3 2026 results timing and disclosing a definitive merger agreement, dated November 1, 2026, under which Affle 3i Limited will acquire all outstanding Perion shares for $11.70 per share in cash, an equity value of roughly $420 million, a 34.5% premium to the October 30, 2026 close. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027, subject to Perion shareholder approval and other conditions. Perion withdrew all guidance, suspended its $200 million buyback (21.3 million shares, $196.8 million repurchased), and will hold no earnings call. Watch the shareholder vote and regulatory clearance timing.
